details.method: For a screen-texture material, render glass A, then a distinct opaque layer B, then glass C, and assert C includes B; retain an opaque fallback check. Evidence text must pass repository spelling checks before its immutable digest is recorded.
details.when: Multiple same-viewport controls use screen-texture backdrop sampling.
details.counterexample: A single glass panel or shared unchanged background cannot distinguish stale screen snapshots. Separate native windows require a different capture model.
details.trial_plan: Run the layered fixture against auto-copy-only and per-panel-copy candidates; require failure for the former and success for the latter. Repeat on each supported renderer before generalizing.
